description: An audit-log-policy artifact defines which actions are logged, the required schema for every log entry, PII masking rules, and data retention periods.

rules.description: Policy must declare feature, non-empty events array (each with action and sensitivity), and a schema object.
Schema must include actor_id, timestamp, source_ip, and action_result.
Schema fields and event logged_fields identified as PII (email, phone, SSN, etc.) must declare mask: true or log_handling: mask/exclude/hash.
For features with >3 events, delete, login, and permission_change actions must be covered by audit events.
retention_days must be a positive number and at minimum 90 days.
